DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、急いで確認したいことがある

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今どこ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: どうしたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 何かあった？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いや、特に何か問題があったわけじゃない

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ただ、よく考えてみたら、この辺りもそんなに安全ではないから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生のことは、私が守らないと

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生は私の、護衛対象だから

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 頼もしい……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そんなに危険かな……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……ふぅ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それで、今はどこに？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さっきのは、無しで……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……でも

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 確かに、もう少し肩の力を抜いても良いかもしれない

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: おかげさまで、少しは楽しめそうだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ、また後で連絡する

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今、時間ある？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 何て言えば良いのか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 実はその

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生の助けが必要で

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: まさかの非常事態！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: すぐ行く、今どの辺り？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この後、位置情報を送る

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: できるだけ早く来てくれると嬉しい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あ、でも無理はしないで

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 急いで行くね、待ってて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さっきはごちそうさま。ありがとう、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さっきも言ったように、言葉だけで済ませたりしないから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この借りは、いつか必ず返す

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、楽しみにしてるね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 何だか、復讐でもされそうな台詞だね……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 期待には応えるよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そういうのじゃない……こんなにお世話になってるのに

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあまた、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……何かが足りない気がする

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私の戦術的直感がそう告げてるの

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: きっとまだ、この夏には何かがあるって

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 戦術的直感……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 何かやり残したことが、ってことかな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それについて、戦略的な話し合いが必要

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 時間はあまり残されてない

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 「戦術」と「戦略」ってややこしいよね……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: とにかく、今から先生のところに行く

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今、どこにいる？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、一つ言い忘れてた

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日のこと、それから今日私が言ったこと

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 全部機密事項だから、誰にも言わないで

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 分かった？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そうなの……？とりあえず、了解

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 忘れないで

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もしこの秘密が漏れたとしたら、間違いなく犯人は先生だから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生以外の人に知られたら、困る

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今、時間ある？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 大丈夫だよ、どうしたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 助けに行った方が良い感じ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いや

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 大したことじゃない

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 用事があるなら、無理して来なくても大丈夫

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ううん、すぐ行くね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: せっかくアズサが呼んでくれたんだから、喜んで

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ありがとう、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ、待ってるから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 遅い時間に呼び出してごめん、来てくれてありがとう

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 夜行性だから大丈夫

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 全然、いつでも大歓迎だよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……そっか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ、また

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ありがとう、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: えっと、今日のことだけじゃなくて……その、色々と

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님. 한 가지 확인할 게 있어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 하지만 생각해보니 이곳도 그리 안전하진 않으니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님의 신변을 위해서라도 내가 경호를 해줘야 할 거 같아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 굳이 그래야 할 것 같진 않은데……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 조금 전 일은…… 없었던 걸로 해.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 덕분에 조금은 편하게 이곳을 즐길 수 있겠어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님. 혹시 지금 시간이 좀 있을까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 빨리 와주면 고맙지만, 너무 무리하지는 마.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 미리 말했듯 나는 맨입으로 감사를 표하진 않아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 뭔가 복수라도 하는 것 같은 말투네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아직이야. 생각해 보니 아직 충분하지 않아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 분명 여기엔 뭔가가 더 있다고 말이야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 또 뭔가 하고 싶은 것이 생겼구나.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 그것에 대해, 전략적인 논의가 필요해.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님. 말하지 않고 잊은 게 있어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘 있었던 일, 오늘 내가 했던 말들.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 극비사항이야. 새어 나가면 반드시 선생님이 범인이지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님 이외에는, 아무도 본 적 없는 거니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 용무가 있다면 필수적으로 와 줄 필요는 없어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 역시 너무 늦게까지 호출하고 있었던 거 같은데.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: There's something I want to check, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What is your location right now?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: My location? Why?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Is there a problem?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Nothing of great concern.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: After further evaluation, I don't believe this beach is safe either.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It would be best if I guarded you myself.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You are a priority subject, after all.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I need to be protected?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I don't think you HAVE to do this...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Where are you right now?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Forget about what just happened.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: At least compared to what I was expecting...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: This place might actually be safe.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: We should be able to stay here without worrying too much, then.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll talk to you next time, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hmm.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you free right now, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I could use some

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: support

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: right about now.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You need support? Are you in battle?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Are you all right? What's your location?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll send you the details.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Earlier the better, but take your time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm on my way.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I enjoyed the meal, Sensei. Thank you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And as I said, I don't thank people without meaning.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll pay you back sometime later.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Sure, I'll look forward to it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You sound like you're out for revenge when you put it like that.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes. Good.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's not like that.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll speak with you later, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's not enough, now that I think of it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: My tactical intuition is telling me

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: that there is something else here.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Tactical intuition? Where's this coming from?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I guess you still aren't satisfied, huh?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I need to discuss strategy with someone.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Didn't you just say 'tactical' earlier?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Where should I head to?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll head to where you are.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: There is something I forgot to tell you, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Everything that happened today, whatever I said...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You must keep it a secret from the others.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Understood?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Is it something confidential now?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Naturally.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's top secret. So if it leaks, I'll know it was you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: That was for only you, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Can you spare some time?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Spare some time? Is there something wrong?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Do you need more support?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: No.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: That's not it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You don't have to come if you're busy.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It's fine. I'm free.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: If you need me, Azusa, then I'm there.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thank you, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll be waiting.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Apologies if I've been contacting you too late at night.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It's fine. I'm a night owl, anyway.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Don't worry about it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Then I'll put it out of my mind.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thank you, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: For everything.

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มีเรื่องอยากให้คุณครูตรวจสอบหน่อยน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ตอนนี้อยู่ที่ไหนเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ที่ไหนงั้นเหรอ? ทำไมเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มีอะไรรึเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เปล่าหรอก ไม่ได้มีปัญหาอะไรหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ฉันคิดดูแล้ว ที่นี่เองก็ไม่ปลอดภัย
เท่าไร

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันคงต้องปกป้องคุณครูแล้วละ
เพื่อความปลอดภัยของคุณครูเอง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: พูดง่ายๆ คือคุ้มครองไงล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: หืม? คุ้มครองครูงั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่เห็นต้องทำแบบนั้นเลย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้วตอนนี้อยู่ที่ไหนล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เรื่องเมื่อกี้... ลืมมันไปเถอะนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: นั่นสินะ หรือว่าบางที...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อาจปลอดภัยกว่าที่คิด...นิดหน่อยก็ได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ต้องขอบคุณคุณครู ทำให้ฉันใช้เวลา
ที่นี่ได้แบบสบายๆ ขึ้น

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้วฉันจะติดต่อไปใหม่นะคุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู พอมีเวลารึเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คือฉัน...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มีเรื่อง...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อยากให้ช่วยนิดหน่อยน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูจะไปเดี๋ยวนี้ละ! เรื่องต่อสู้เรอะ!?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เป็นอะไรรึเปล่า? ตอนนี้อยู่ที่ไหนน่ะ!?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เดี๋ยวฉันส่งข้อความไปบอกสถานที่นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันอยากให้คุณครูรีบมาก็จริง... แต่ว่า
ไม่ต้องรีบมากก็ได้นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: จะไปเดี๋ยวนี้แหละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อร่อยมากเลยละคุณครู ขอบคุณนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อย่างที่ฉันเคยบอกทุกครั้ง ฉันไม่
ขอบคุณแค่ลมปากหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: สักวันนึงฉันจะตอบแทนคุณครูเอง

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ก็ได้ แล้วครูจะรอนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: พูดเหมือนกำลังเตรียมจะล้างแค้นเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ คอยดูได้เลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ใช่แบบนั้นสักหน่อย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้นไว้เจอกันใหม่นะ คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ...คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ยังหรอก พอมาคิดดูแล้ว เท่านี้ยังไม่
พอหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ลางสังหรณ์ด้านกลยุทธ์ของฉันบอก
ว่าอย่างนั้นน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ที่นี่จะต้องมีอะไรอยู่อีกแน่ๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ทำไมจู่ๆ ถึงสังหรณ์ใจแบบนั้นล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มีเรื่องที่อยากทำอยู่สินะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เพราะงั้นเราต้องมาหารือกันเรื่องกลยุทธ์

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เมื่อกี้พูดว่า "กลยุทธ์" ใช่มั้ยนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ต้องไปที่ไหนล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เดี๋ยวฉันไปหาคุณครูเอง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู มีเรื่องนึงที่ฉันลืมบอกไป

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เรื่องที่เกิดขึ้นวันนี้ สิ่งที่ฉันพูดไปวันนี้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ช่วยเก็บเรื่องทุกอย่างไว้เป็นความลับ
ด้วยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เข้าใจมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ความลับสุดยอดงั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แน่นอน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ความลับสุดยอด ถ้าเรื่องนี้หลุดออกไป
ก็คงเป็นฝีมือคุณครูแน่ๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เพราะนอกจากคนอื่นแล้ว ยังไม่เคยมี
ใครได้เห็นเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ตอนนี้มีเวลาว่างรึเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เวลาว่างเหรอ...? มีเรื่องอะไรงั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ต้องการให้ไปช่วยอีกเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เปล่าหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ใช่แบบนั้นหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้าคุณครูติดธุระอยู่ ไม่ต้องมาก็ได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่เป็นไรหรอก ครูว่างอยู่พอดีน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อาซึสะเรียกทั้งทีก็ต้องไปอยู่แล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอบคุณนะ คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้นฉันจะรอนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันคิดว่าส่งข้อความหาคุณครูดึกเกินไป
ซะอีก

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูเป็นสิ่งมีชีวิตกลางคืนน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่เป็นไรหรอก ไม่ต้องห่วง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้นฉันจะคิดแบบนั้นแล้วกัน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอบคุณนะ คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หลายๆ เรื่องเลย

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，有件事想盡快和你確認一下

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不，並沒有發生什麼狀況

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 只是仔細想想，這附近並不是那麼安全

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 因為老師是我的護衛對象

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 稍微放鬆一下確實不壞

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 託你的福，我好像能稍微享受現況了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我馬上過去，你現在在哪？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 等等我會傳送位置資訊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 剛才多謝款待。謝謝老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 就像剛才說過的，光用說的無法表達我的謝意

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這筆帳，總有一天必定奉還

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 怎麼聽起來像是要復仇一樣……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不是那個意思……我明明這麼受老師關照

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我的戰術直覺是這麼告訴我的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這個夏天一定還少了什麼

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 關於這點，需要進行戰略性的討論

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 總之，我現在過去老師那邊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天的事，還有今天我說的話

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 全部都是機密事項，不要告訴任何人

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果這個祕密洩露出去，犯人肯定是老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果被老師以外的人知道，我會很困擾

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果有事的話，不用勉強過來沒關係

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 難得被梓邀請，我很樂意

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 很抱歉這麼晚叫你出來，謝謝你來

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我是夜行性動物，沒事的

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 別在意，任何時候都歡迎

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那個，不只是今天的事……各方面都是……
